code_paths.purpose: Handles a node received during consensus transaction set acquisition. If the node is a transaction, validates its hash and submits it for processing.
Retrieves a node (transaction) from cache or transaction master, serializes it, and validates its hash before returning the data.

flow: Used as hash to validate transaction
data_flows.validated_at: XRPL_ASSERT in both gotNode and getNode

transformations: Checked for minimum size to be considered a transaction

description: Implements the ConsensusTransSetSF class, which acts as a sync filter for transaction sets during consensus in the XRPL, handling node acquisition and transaction submission.
